servers.name: RCQ Flagship
servers.description: Default backend operated by the RCQ maintainer. AGPL-3.0 source at github.com/rcq-messenger/rcq-server-ref. Hosted in Frankfurt.

servers.name: RCQ Second Island
servers.description: The maintainer's second island, independent of the flagship: its own accounts, its own keys, its own data, and cross-island messaging with api.rcq.app (add somebody as uin@api.rcq.app). No push notifications on this one yet. Hosted in Frankfurt.

servers.name: Project26's RCQ
servers.description: RCQ island operated by Project26, hosted in Netherlands

servers.name: Amsterdam Island
servers.description: Public ephemeral RCQ relay in Netherlands. High privacy, automatic message expiration.

servers.name: Singapore Island
servers.description: Public ephemeral RCQ relay in Singapore. High privacy, automatic message expiration.

servers.name: Falcon
servers.description: A small private island run out of the US. Open to everyone: no invites, no fees, no ads.
